verdict.rationale: Evidence covers escalation policies, on-call scheduling, and notification cascades, but there is no mention of alert deduplication or incident grouping logic. In fact, docs-19/docs-53 describe '30 incidents created at the same time' with bulk one-tap acknowledgment as the mitigation — implying duplicates still spawn separate incidents rather than being merged into a single paged incident. No evidence of true dedup/grouping into one incident exists.
